prompt:
Dramatic pastoral literary graphic novel illustration, painterly watercolor and gouache with selective fine ink contours, cinematic chiaroscuro, natural expressive faces, rich restrained colors, tactile period materials, gentle atmospheric depth, strong silhouettes and meaningful visual storytelling. Never cartoon enlarged eyes, generic cute faces, photorealistic skin or glossy 3D.
Create ONE scene landscape 1536x1024. Low-angle MEDIUM two-sided confrontation at a timber river bridge, Poland circa1920, blue moonlit NIGHT. On LEFT a visiting officer from the front in period Polish uniform, older than Yitzhak, stands tall and indicates with one firm outstretched arm that Yitzhak should move, several indistinct soldier silhouettes behind him. On RIGHT Yitzhak early twenties stands straight calm and resolute holding his period rifle upright safely, no aiming. BOTH speakers visible waist-up, faces within middle 70%; broad quiet dark blue sky above both for TWO later speech balloons, especially above left officer and right Yitzhak. Yitzhak follows supplied youth photo: youthful narrow oval face, prominent ears, restrained mouth, straight nose, clean shaven, not43. Same uniform and cap as photo. NO violence, enemy, battle or sunrise. One continuous image, no lettering, NO balloons, NO circles, NO borders. Purpose: steadfastness in obeying his own commander. Other officer is a proposed supporting face, no verified portrait.
